capture_method: Original fetch_execution_snapshot with in-process request_json raw-preserving wrapper; original code files unchanged
cost_unit: bps per complete round trip per unit of gross leg notional; pairs sum positive legweights times leg costs
funding_reserve: p95(abs(last100observed fundingRate))*10000, one settlement reserve, no credit
historical_interpretation: Same current-observed reference cost scenario applied to historical prices; NOT actual historical spread/impact/funding and NOT complete historical funding settlement reconstruction
limitations: Depth quantity/base-unit semantics are not independently proven by this capture; inherited VWAP assumption remains a scenario assumption.
Fee schedule is inherited frozen source authority, not a newly verified personal fee tier.
Funding100 rows are contemporaneously fetched actual response rows, not 12-month fundinghistory.
One-settlement p95 reserve does not prove actual cost for multi-settlement holdings.
No promotion/selection/order/live authority is granted by scenario cost arithmetic.
price_timeframe: CurrentScalp7 15m/30m execution engine; parent authority latency NEXT_1H_BAR_OPEN is explicitly not inherited
two_leg_binding: Cost1x=sum(weight_leg*costs_bps[symbol]);cost2x doubles both legs; no synthetic offset or netting
